hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */NotchSuite.xcodeproj/*|*/Package.resolved) printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated, gitignored file. Change project.yml or Package.swift and regenerate instead."}}';; esac; }

jq -r '[.tool_name, (.tool_response.type // ""), (.tool_input.file_path // "")] | join("|")' | { IFS='|' read -r t ty f; m=; case "$f" in */project.yml) m=1;; */App/*.swift) [ "$t" = Write ] && [ "$ty" = create ] && m=1;; esac; [ -n "$m" ] && printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"project.yml or the App/ file set changed: run xcodegen generate before building the Xcode project."}}'; true; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.swift) swift format format --in-place "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
